BiblicalUsage: An islet is a small island, and this one is Clauda, the little island under whose lee Paul's ship runs in the storm on the way to Rome. The crew fights to save the boat there, in the last shelter before the open sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives small shelters in great storms: Clauda was not the destination, but it was the lee that kept the boat alive.
